title: معارض قمم للمنزل وساعات العمل
text:
ترحب معارض قمم للمنزل بالعملاء لمعاينة المنتجات والحصول على الاستشارات التصميمية.
- يقع المعرض الرئيسي في الرياض على شارع العليا في حي العليا.
- يقع معرض جدة على شارع الأمير محمد بن عبدالعزيز (شارع التحلية) في حي الأندلس.
- يقع معرض الدمام على شارع الملك سعود في حي الفيصلية.

title: معارض قمم للمنزل وساعات العمل
text:
تعمل المعارض من السبت إلى الخميس من ١٠:٠٠ إلى ٢٣:٠٠. تعمل المعارض يوم الجمعة من ١٦:٠٠ إلى ٢٣:٠٠.
قد تتغير ساعات العمل خلال المواسم والأعياد، ويُعلن عن ذلك مسبقًا.

title: معارض قمم للمنزل وساعات العمل
text: يُفتتح معرض شمال الرياض الجديد على طريق الملك سلمان في ١٥ نوفمبر ٢٠٢٦.

title: Delivery and Installation Charges
text: Delivery within Riyadh is free for orders above 1,500 SAR; otherwise the fee is 150 SAR.

title: Delivery and Installation Charges
text:
Installation fees depend on the product type and the location.
Installation is free for standard pieces such as beds, wardrobes and sofas. Kitchen installation is charged at a flat fee of 1,200 SAR.
A fee of 75 SAR per floor applies above the 3rd floor in buildings without an elevator.

title: Delivery and Installation Charges
text: Installation is scheduled within 48 hours of delivery. The installation team confirms the appointment with the customer by phone.

title: سياسة التوصيل
text:

التوصيل داخل الرياض مجاني للطلبات التي تتجاوز ١,٥٠٠ ريال سعودي، وإلا فرسوم التوصيل ١٥٠ ريالًا سعوديًا.
رسوم التوصيل في جدة والدمام ٢٠٠ ريال سعودي. رسوم التوصيل إلى المدن الأخرى ٣٥٠ ريالًا سعوديًا.

title: Employee Handbook - Working Time and Leave
text:
Standard working hours are 8 hours a day from Sunday to Thursday, 8:00 to 17:00,
including a one-hour break. Employees record attendance through the Employee Portal.

title: Employee Handbook - Working Time and Leave
text:
Employees with less than 5 years of service are entitled to 21 days of annual leave.
Employees with 5 or more years of service are entitled to 30 days of annual leave.
Up to 10 unused annual leave days can be carried over to the next year.

title: Employee Handbook - Working Time and Leave
text:
Employees receive full pay for the first 30 days of sick leave in a year and 75% pay for the
following 60 days. A medical certificate is required for every sick leave request.
Male employees are entitled to 3 days of paid paternity leave on the birth of a child.

title: Employee Handbook - Working Time and Leave
text:
The probation period for new employees is 90 days. Employees must give 60 days' notice
before resigning.

title: Employee Handbook - Working Time and Leave
text:
Overtime is paid at 150% of the basic hourly wage. Overtime must be approved in advance
by the line manager.
Employees and up to 4 dependants are covered by class A medical insurance.

title: Ticket Priorities and Escalation Procedure
text: This procedure explains how support tickets are prioritised and how unresolved critical issues are escalated inside the Qimam Home support organisation.

title: Ticket Priorities and Escalation Procedure
text:
- Priority 1 (critical): the customer cannot use a delivered product at all, or there is a safety risk.
- Priority 2 (high): a product can be used but a major function is affected.
- Priority 3 (normal): general questions, cosmetic issues and information requests.

title: Ticket Priorities and Escalation Procedure
text:
Priority 1 (critical) tickets not resolved within 2 hours are escalated to the duty support manager.
The duty support manager reviews the ticket, assigns additional technicians if required and keeps the customer informed until the issue is closed.

title: Ticket Priorities and Escalation Procedure
text: Customers can ask for an escalation by replying to the ticket and explaining why the issue is urgent. The support agent records the request and informs the team leader.

title: الأسئلة الشائعة حول خدمة العملاء والدعم

title: Customer Support Plans and Service Levels
text:
Qimam Home offers four customer support plans so that households and businesses can
choose the level of service that fits their needs. Every request is logged as a ticket in the
support portal and measured against the service levels described in this document.
Service levels are stated either in business hours or in business days, as indicated for each
plan.

title: Customer Support Plans and Service Levels
text:
The Basic plan suits customers who need occasional help with orders, deliveries and
product care.
Basic support plan tickets receive a first response within 24 hours. Basic support plan
tickets are resolved within 5 business days.

title: Customer Support Plans and Service Levels
text:
The Standard plan is intended for customers who want faster handling and direct access to
support agents.
Standard support plan tickets receive a first response within 8 hours. Standard support
plan tickets are resolved within 3 business days.
Standard support is available by email and live chat from Sunday to Thursday, 8:00 to
20:00.

title: Customer Support Plans and Service Levels
text:
The Premium plan is designed for customers who need priority handling and round-the-
clock availability.
Premium support plan tickets receive a first response within 1 hour. Premium support plan
tickets are resolved within 8 business hours.
Premium support is available by phone, live chat and email 24/7.

title: Customer Support Plans and Service Levels
text:
The Enterprise plan is designed for corporate customers who operate several sites or a
large number of workstations.
Enterprise support plan tickets receive a first response within 30 minutes. Enterprise
support plan tickets are resolved within 4 business hours.

title: Customer Support Plans and Service Levels
text:
Basic: first response 24 hours, resolution 5 business days
Standard: first response 8 hours, resolution 3 business days
Premium: first response 1 hour, resolution 8 business hours
Enterprise: first response 30 minutes, resolution 4 business hours
